name: Astro Group Packages
tagline: Build the campaign across Astro, not around one placement.
intro: The Astro Upfront 2027 deck brings together TV, audio, talent, digital, on-ground and production options. Group packages are distinct from a single channel buy.

ideas.title: Media mix
ideas.body: Compare the relevant Upfront 2027 package sections and decide which channels serve the brief.

ideas.title: Terms review
ideas.body: Confirm production, entitlements, validity and the current commercial conditions.

name: Astro Video360
tagline: Plan a video journey across screens.
intro: The Video360+ and Digital Solutions 2026 deck provides a distinct cross-screen video advertising reference.

ideas.title: Cross-screen brief
ideas.body: Choose the target viewing context and review the available Video360+ formats.

ideas.title: Measurement plan
ideas.body: Confirm reporting, targeting options, dates and the applicable commercial package.

name: Bernama.com
tagline: Make information useful online.
intro: The Bernama media kit includes website advertising, coverage and production services for its digital portal.

ideas.title: Website placements
ideas.body: Review the BERNAMA.com advertising formats in the source deck.

ideas.title: Production support
ideas.body: Discuss approved content production and distribution requirements.

name: Bernama Wire
tagline: Distribution begins with a clear story.
intro: The national news agency’s wire service is a separate media property in the catalogue. Independent editorial coverage must not be represented as a guaranteed purchase.

ideas.title: Distribution scope
ideas.body: Ask which commercial writing or distribution services are available for the particular brief.

ideas.title: Editorial distinction
ideas.body: Confirm exactly what is sponsored content and what remains independent journalism.

name: Bernama Group
tagline: A coordinated communications brief.
intro: The 2026 Bernama kit includes strategic writing, coverage, archives, TV, radio and production services.

ideas.title: Content and distribution
ideas.body: Select the relevant service and platform instead of assuming blanket group coverage.

ideas.title: Source comparison
ideas.body: Review the specific rate-card sections and approved deliverables.

name: Sarawak Media Group (SMG)
tagline: A digital outdoor route through Sarawak.
intro: The Sarawak Digital Billboard Network 2026 deck identifies Kuching and Bintulu inventory, including Taman Heritage, Tun Salahuddin and Tun Taib sites.

ideas.title: Site shortlist
ideas.body: Compare actual site formats and geographical relevance.

ideas.title: Package comparison
ideas.body: Review the deck’s bundle and normal-rate options, confirming current availability.

name: Bus
tagline: A moving canvas for Klang Valley campaigns.
intro: The bus-wrap reference is listed under RA Media Relations. Verify route coverage, production and posting dates before booking.

ideas.title: Route selection
ideas.body: Confirm the actual routes and vehicle availability for the campaign.

ideas.title: Wrap production
ideas.body: Review approved dimensions, materials and installation lead time.

name: Media Prima Omnia (Cubig)
tagline: Large-format attention at KLCC Junction.
intro: The Cubig KLCC Junction 2026 reference lists a welcome-back promotion and a commitment promotion for premium digital out-of-home.

ideas.title: Campaign commitment
ideas.body: Compare listed promotional options and the actual commitment terms.

ideas.title: Screen-ready artwork
ideas.body: Confirm the screen specification, duration and availability.

name: ERL
tagline: Reach travellers between the terminal and city.
intro: The ERL digital-screens 2026 reference separates the in-train network from Ekspres and Transit stations.

ideas.title: In-train screens
ideas.body: Review the available network formats and creative specifications.

ideas.title: Station screens
ideas.body: Confirm the actual stations and placement dates before booking.

name: IKIMfm
tagline: Respectful audio for Ramadan and beyond.
intro: The IKIMfm Ramadan 2027 rate card contains prayer-time announcements, jingles, special capsules, tazkirah and drama formats.

ideas.title: Ramadan sponsorship
ideas.body: Review the specific seasonal packages and dates.

ideas.title: Content suitability
ideas.body: Confirm religious-content and advertiser-eligibility requirements before commissioning creative.

name: KLCC Snorkels
tagline: A landmark lightbox, not a generic billboard.

ideas.title: Site format
ideas.body: Confirm which lightbox faces and durations are available.

ideas.title: Artwork review
ideas.body: Match the design to the actual source-deck placement dimensions.

name: DBP
tagline: A street-level digital route in Kuala Lumpur.
intro: The lamppost digital-bunting 2026 reference lists Jalan Tun Razak, Jalan Dutamas and Jalan Cheras sets.

ideas.title: Route selection
ideas.body: Compare the actual listed road segments against your intended geography.

ideas.title: Production and fees
ideas.body: Review the source deck's additional costs and creative requirements.

name: Malaysiakini
tagline: News-context storytelling and event coverage.
intro: The catalogue includes a Malaysiakini media kit and a separate Malaysiakini/KiniTV event-coverage reference.

ideas.title: Digital editorial-style content
ideas.body: Discuss clearly disclosed commercial content separately from independent news.

ideas.title: Event coverage brief
ideas.body: Review the actual KiniTV event-coverage reference and approved production scope.

name: Media Prima Audio Group

ideas.title: Station mix

ideas.title: Trade-show reference
ideas.body: Review actual group packages and the specific station inclusions.

name: RA Media (Raptor Truck)
tagline: Bring a campaign directly to the crowd.

ideas.title: Mobile activation

ideas.title: Production scope
ideas.body: Confirm truck specifications, logistics, staffing and dates.

name: Media Prima Omnia Group

ideas.title: Package review
ideas.body: Confirm programme entitlements, validity and availability in the actual deck.

name: Remedy Resources
tagline: Understand the quoted campaign reference.

ideas.body: Use the actual quotation only to understand the listed scope.

ideas.title: New brief
ideas.body: Request current deliverables, timing and commercial terms independently.

name: RA Media Group
tagline: Choose the right format for the message.

ideas.title: Talkshow brief
ideas.body: Confirm channel, format, speaker, content and production scope.

ideas.title: News-slot enquiry

name: RA Media Relations
tagline: Connect strategy, creative and delivery.
intro: The RA Media website media-solutions reference lists the agency’s own services separately from broadcaster inventory.

ideas.title: Service brief
ideas.body: Define the objective, media formats and deliverables required.

ideas.title: Proposal review
ideas.body: Discuss the actual production and distribution scope, costs and timeline.

name: RTM Group Packages
tagline: Plan national and regional public-broadcast formats.
intro: The RTM TV and radio 2025 reference includes channel-specific and group-level options.

ideas.title: Broadcast selection

ideas.title: Historical terms

name: Sinar Karangkraf Group

ideas.title: Package review
ideas.body: Compare the actual catalogue sections and confirm availability.

name: Target Media

ideas.title: Building selection
ideas.body: Confirm the actual elevator locations, occupancy context and campaign dates.

ideas.title: Operational costs

ideas.title: Production and schedule

name: TVS Group

intro: The TVS 2026 deck includes TV commercial spot buys, programme entitlements, branded participation, website/OTT and social formats.

ideas.title: Cross-format mix

ideas.title: Entitlements check
ideas.body: Confirm programme participation, duration, rights and commercial conditions.
